elements.description: A suggestion with a confidence signal, alternatives and one-click accept and undo.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the region's name

properties.name: options
properties.description: The first entry is the recommendation, the rest are offered as alternatives. A new set starts over

properties.name: value
properties.description: Id of the option on show; empty shows the recommendation

properties.name: accepted
properties.description: Id of the accepted option, or null

properties.name: acceptOption
properties.description: Called to accept an option; a returned promise keeps the button pending, a rejection says so

properties.name: undoOption
properties.description: Called to take an acceptance back, like acceptOption

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: An option was picked from the Alternatives menu, or a new set of options went back to the recommendation ({ value: string, reset: boolean }); cancelable

events.name: tc-accepted-change
events.description: An option was accepted, or the acceptance taken back ({ accepted: string | null, reset: boolean }); cancelable

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The reason was folded or unfolded ({ open: boolean }); cancelable

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name – "Smart recommendation" by default

props.name: options
props.description:
First entry is the recommendation, the rest are offered as alternatives. A new set of options starts over
(uncontrolled choice and acceptance go back to the recommendation); an empty list shows the card with nothing to accept

props.name: value
props.description: Id of the option on show (controlled when defined) – the recommendation or an alternative

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The option on show at first when uncontrolled – defaults to the recommendation

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when an alternative (or the recommendation again) is picked from the menu

props.name: accepted
props.description: Id of the accepted option, or null (controlled when defined). onAccept / onUndo report the changes

props.name: defaultAccepted
props.description: The accepted option at first when uncontrolled – null by default

props.name: onAccept
props.description:
Accepts the option. Return a promise to keep the button pending until it settles: the option counts as
accepted once it resolves, and a rejection says so and lets you try again

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Takes the acceptance back – may return a promise, like onAccept

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the reason is unfolded (controlled when defined)

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the reason starts unfolded when uncontrolled – true by default

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the reason is folded or unfolded
